subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Should WhatsApp sticker support transport only explicitly supplied sticker-ready WebP, or also convert arbitrary static and animated media into WhatsApp-compliant stickers?
rationale: The first option is a narrow channel contract using an existing sender; the second commits OpenClaw to image/video conversion, animation handling, metadata generation, additional dependencies, and broader failure semantics that cannot be selected safely from source behavior alone.

options.title: Transport sticker-ready WebP
options.body: Add an explicit sticker action for validated WebP input and leave media conversion to external tools or a later feature.

options.title: Convert arbitrary media
options.body: Add a send-as-sticker mode that converts static and animated inputs and owns encoding, metadata, limits, and diagnostics.

options.title: Defer public support
options.body: Keep the low-level sender limited to QA and internal transport use until a broader media-conversion direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Transport sticker-ready WebP
recommendation.body: Add an explicit sticker action for validated WebP input and leave media conversion to external tools or a later feature.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent history signal spans both the WhatsApp send path and shared media behavior needed to define this contract.
